scope: Independent instrumented Java 17 JMH diagnostic JVM, including startup, setup, two 1-second warmups, two 1-second measurements, harness and teardown. No phase filtering. CPU sampling requests 10ms; allocation sampling is throttled to 50 events/second; recording and export retain up to 64 frames. This is not main timing evidence, per-operation allocation, retained heap, method duration, p99 latency, RSS or production capacity.
